deals.title: La Madonna col Bambino tra i santi Caterina d’Alessandria e Giacomo maggiore è un dipinto a olio su tela (95,5x69,5 cm) di Lorenzo Lotto, da
deals.description: La Madonna col Bambino tra i santi Caterina d’Alessandria e Giacomo maggiore è un dipinto a olio su tela (95,5x69,5 cm) di Lorenzo Lotto, databile al 1527 circa e conservato nel Kunsthistorisches Museum, Wien. In a country landscape, in the shade of a tree, the Virgin and Child sits informally, next to Saint Catherine of Alexandria, with a book in her hand (recognizable by the princely robes and the broken toothed wheel barely visible between her and Mary), and St. James Major, with the pilgrim’s stick and in a praying position, while behind her a young and sensual angel crowns her with a garland of leaves and flowers. The reduced colour, the wide draperies, the liveliness of movements and gestures show Lotto’s return to the beds of Venetian painting, after the long stay in Lombardy, however maintaining the dynamism of the lights and the free combination of the tones, without aligning itself too much with the placid elegiac feeling of the followers of Giorgione and Tiziano, but still looking for a sumptuous colour and a courtly tone, able to satisfy the clients. The work, which shows an extraordinary pictorial quality, however, detaches itself from the pyramidal compositions at the Palm, with more dynamic and restless figures, tracing a dense network of imaginary diagonal lines, with sudden flashes of light and draperies with restless lines. #art #artcommunity #wien #fyp
